name: 1. Stable readings: no alert reaches the nurse
2. Mild change, companion responds in time: nurse not alerted
detail: companion alerted, response logged, nurse panel stayed clear after 10 s

name: 3. Mild change, no response: alert escalates to nurse after the 10 s timeout
detail: no nurse alert at 5 s; nurse alert present by 11.5 s; reason logged

name: 4. Mild change while companion is far (30 m): nurse alerted at once
5. Severe deterioration: nurse and companion alerted together
detail: critical alert on both within 0.4 s

name: 6. Companion walks away during an open alert: escalates to nurse
detail: escalated within about 1 s of leaving; reason logged

name: 7. Companion out of range: monitoring interval tightens and patient shows as alone
detail: 60 s with companion, 15 s beyond 15 m; queue marks patient alone

name: 8. Handover to nurse: nurse sees the patient is in their care
9. Handover to another relative: band re-paired to the new companion
detail: companion changed from daughter to son

name: 10. Companion reports chest pain: priority rises and nurse alerted
11. Turn call: companion band directs to clinic 3
detail: turn call shown on companion band

name: 12. Nurse can open each patient card with all vital signs
detail: switched between 4 patients; each card shows 7 vital fields

name: 13. Companion reports confusion: 3 NEWS2 points and nurse alerted
detail: confusion shown on card with 3 points; nurse alerted
